title: The Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording of the rare ’82 Dew show, highlighted by a smoking Not Fade Away and a tight second‑set performance.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a collector’s gem with clear vocals, a standout Brent‑B3 on “Not Fade Away,” and a solid, energetic second set. The soundboard mix is described as crisp and well‑balanced, though one listener notes the playback was sped up, which slightly mars an otherwise excellent recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently rate the show 4–5 stars, emphasizing strong musical performance and good soundboard quality; only a single comment about speed issues tempers an otherwise high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑blended mix with clear vocals; occasional sped‑up playback noted, and a hint of Jerry sounding tired in places.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as solid with no slouch, second set praised for its energy and tight playing; overall flow regarded as strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals sound great and expressive, though a reviewer notes he sounds a bit tired at times.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's B3 organ on Not Fade Away is highlighted as a major positive; noted as the new kid having fun.
